sloka: यस्याः कृते वने रामः न्यस्त देहः च वः पिता ।सा इयम् पापा नृशम्सा च तस्याः कुरु यथा मति ॥२-७८-९॥
transliteration: yasyāḥ kṛte vane rāmaḥ nyasta dehaḥ ca vaḥ pitā ।sā iyam pāpā nṛśamsā ca tasyāḥ kuru yathā mati ॥2-78-9॥

translations.english: Here is that sinful, cruel woman on whose account Rama is in the forest and your father has forsaken his body. Do with her as it pleases you.
